[name="阿米娅"]  梅菲斯特，你才是这战场上孤身一人的那个！
[Character(name="char_1507_Mephisto_1#4")]

[Character(name="char_002_amiya_1#7",name2="char_1508_Faust_1#1",focus=2)]
